methods.what: Physical model in which layered media act like a lens: parallel vibration waves are refracted by the nested, elliptically bounded capsules and focused onto the terminal fibre. The condition is that the inner layers are denser and less elastic than the outer sheaths.

items.english: The parallel lines e indicate the direction of vibration waves which come from the outer skin surface and are concentrated in the line dd, provided that the more darkly shaded parts possess greater density and lower elasticity than the sheaths.
